mapper.select: select id-1 as dt, ifnull(bb.cnt, 0) as num from (select id, concat(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(date_format(#{dtStr}, '%Y-%m-%d'), interval id-1 HOUR ), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), '') AS 'time' from SysSequence order by id asc limit 24) aa left join (select concat(date_format(FROM_UNIXTIME(a.createTime / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d %H'), ':00') as time,count(distinct a.id) cnt from Account a where source = #{source} and date_format(FROM_UNIXTIME(a.createTime/1000) , '%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{dtStr} , '%Y-%m-%d') group by date_format(FROM_UNIXTIME(a.createTime/1000), '%Y-%m-%d %H') order by a.createTime asc) bb on aa.time = bb.time
